title: 5.3.3 Asteroid Field — Challenge
description: A ship flies through asteroids. Bullets (a Group) destroy asteroids on overlap; hitting one ends the game.

steps.title: Ship with rotate + thrust
steps.instructions: Left/right rotate the ship; up applies thrust in its facing direction.
hints: Use Math.cos(ship.rotation) and Math.sin(ship.rotation) for thrust vector.

steps.title: Asteroid group
steps.instructions: An `asteroids` Group with several sprites drifting across the screen. Wrap x/y when offscreen.

steps.title: Bullets group
steps.instructions: Space (kb.presses) spawns a bullet from the ship's nose with velocity in the ship's direction.
hints: Short-lived — remove bullets that go offscreen.

steps.title: Overlap rules
steps.instructions: Bullet overlaps asteroid → both .remove(). Ship overlaps asteroid → game over (stop updating, show text).

requirements.title: Two or more Groups
requirements.description: Create at least two Groups (asteroids and bullets)
